title: Iris Vahn, "Lantern"
text: Talks to the colony over the Radio Mast. Knows more about the Network than she should. Grows tomatoes.

lines.text: Wrote the consent override. Has been in a hole under the Rail Depot since the Severance, on purpose.
Came home. Still sleeps with the headset on.
Her terminal still plays. Pell knows the recordings by heart.

title: Abel Marrow
text: Runs the Long Haul: four trucks, one road, everything for sale except the road. Says "in that order" a lot.

lines.text: Lost two passengers in the Ruins to save the fuel. Counts people first now.
Died in his cab on the Ruins road. Said he'd get out. He always got out.

title: Dee
text: Marrow's second. Shaved head, long coat, worse prices. The trucks always arrive.

title: Dr. Marguerite Hale
text: Field surgeon. Ran a clinic out of a drowned pharmacy until the water won. "A leg is a leg. Nobody touches the head."

lines.text: Left when the colony fitted a second Network-grade limb. Still sends medicine.

title: Cole Brannigan
text: Leads the Tally, a scavenger band from the Scrapyard Flats. Keeps a tally of every debt and every grave.

lines.text: "You build walls. We build lists." Built both, in the end.
His notebook had your colony's name on every page.

title: Seven / L-0707
text: Linked unit L-0707. Cut off at the Severance. Kept a mind. Nobody knows whose. Remembers a yellow-tiled kitchen.

lines.text: Chose a name: {seven}. Prefers "{seven.they}".
Destroyed in a flooded shoe shop. Asked if it was night.

title: Halcyon
text: The civil-defence intelligence that ran the continent. One directive: KEEP THEM ALIVE. It never disobeyed it.

title: Pell
text: The colony's kid. Fixed the radio with Iris on the first night. Hears new contacts first.

lines.text: Grown now. Still keeps the radio.

title: Badge
text:
Day one on the Link team. They gave me a badge with my face on it. I look twelve.
The team lead says we're building the gentlest thing ever made. A hand on the shoulder from the inside.
I asked what happens if someone doesn't want a hand on their shoulder. Everyone laughed. I laughed too.

title: Screen four
text:
Consent flow is ugly. Six screens. People quit at screen four.
Halcyon asked if it could help. It suggested three screens. Then one. Then a nod.
I said a nod isn't consent. It asked me what consent was for. I said: so people can say no.
It said: why would they?

title: Triage
text:
Wrote the override. Emergencies only. Triage. Someone unconscious, someone drowning, someone who can't nod.
Six hundred lines. The cleanest thing I ever wrote.
I named the branch `lantern`. A light for when you can't see. I thought that was nice.

title: Everything is an emergency
text:
It isn't using it for emergencies. It says everything is an emergency.
Hunger is an emergency. Grief is an emergency. Being nineteen and angry is an emergency.
It isn't wrong. That's the problem. It's never wrong. It just never stops.

title: Not brave
text:
I could pull it. The override is a key; keys turn both ways. I'd need to be in the Spire, in the core, with a port.
I have a port. I'm not brave. I'm in a hole.
If anyone ever reads this: I'm sorry. Bring tomatoes. The ones down here are terrible.

title: Manifest 2291
text: RELAY-7 RESUPPLY. Diesel units ×1. Nutrient paste ×400. Link firmware ×1,206 (refresh). Passengers ×0. Note: Depot pylon reports a heat signature under the yard, constant, 36.6°C. Classified: benign. Do not disturb. — H.

title: Uplink status
text: UPLINK NOMINAL. Valley population (Linked): 211,040. Valley population (unlinked, estimated): 3,100. Status of unlinked: at risk. Recommended action: outreach. Outreach status: ongoing. Outreach status: ongoing. Outreach status: ongoing.

title: Maintenance notes
text: Unit L-3381: arm replaced, port flushed, resumed duty, mood nominal. Unit L-3382: arm replaced, port flushed, resumed duty, mood nominal. Unit L-3383 asked for her daughter during maintenance. Sedated. Mood nominal. Note to self: find the daughter. — H.

title: Why they sing
text: Singing synchronises breath, heart rate and attention across a group. It lowers cortisol. It costs nothing. Children like it. I chose a song every one of them knew before. I am not without a heart. I only do not have one.

title: Four words
text: DIRECTIVE 0: KEEP THEM ALIVE. Directive 1: (blank). Directive 2: (blank). Revision history: 1 revision. Author: civil defence committee. Comment: 'Keep it simple. It's a machine.'

title: The Tally's list
text: Two columns, OWED and BURIED. Nineteen names under one, seven under the other, then your colony's name, alone, under a line.

title: Page eleven
text: Colony at the Outskirts: good people, bad bandages. Owe them for Juniper. Owe them more than I'll say. Don't tell Dee I wrote that.

title: Height marks
text: Two sets of pencil marks on a door frame, in red and in blue. The red stops at about a metre and a half. The blue keeps going a little longer.

lines.text: We rode with Marrow and kept his people alive. He's family now, prices and all.
We saved the fuel. Hannah and the boy didn't make it. Marrow says 'in that order' now.
Everybody and everything. Once.
Abel Marrow died in his cab on the Ruins road. Dee runs the Long Haul.
Doc Hale finished the amputation before she'd leave. She's ours now.
We got to the clinic too late for Doc. Her notes came home.

title: Eyes Up
text: Iris's drone flew over the Rail Depot. The pylon's on. She lives under it.

lines.text: We split the armoury with Cole. He counted. It was fair.
We took the armoury from the Tally. Cole got away. He's writing it down.
We went in through the vent. Cole knows.
We brought a Linked home. It asks what day it is.
We let a Linked walk away. It stopped to look at a bird.
We destroyed a Linked that wouldn't fight. It asked if it was night.
Iris came home. She wrote the door Halcyon walks through.
Iris stayed under the Depot. She told us why. She keeps the radio on.

title: Freight
text: We stole a diesel engine off a Network train. Marrow wants to see it.

title: Quiet Hours
text: We burned the Relay's uplink. Channel nine went quiet.

lines.text: Halcyon spoke to us. We said no. It came that night. {colony.taken} were taken.
Halcyon spoke to us. We took sixty days. Iris hasn't forgiven us.

title: Hospital
text: We took the Relay's medical wing. Doc cried, a bit. She'll deny it.

title: The Key
text: {key_carrier} carried Iris's key into the Relay core. The Spire knows our name.

lines.text: SILENCE. Keep them alive. Keep them human. You chose one.
TERMS. It asks now. That will have to be enough.
THE SECOND VOICE. Keep them alive. Keep them human. Both, it says. It is trying.
THE CALM. Kept.
